name: @ai-zen/cli
description: AI-ZEN CLI - dual-mode AI terminal: pure stdio pipelines and an interactive TUI

scripts.check:imports: node scripts/check-imports.mjs dist/index.js --forbid openai --forbid @modelcontextprotocol --forbid dayjs && node scripts/check-imports.mjs dist/commands/index.js --forbid ink --forbid react --forbid ./tui/ && node scripts/check-imports.mjs dist/session.js --forbid ink --forbid react --forbid ./tui/ && node scripts/check-imports.mjs dist/stdio.js --forbid ink --forbid react --forbid ./tui/
scripts.test:e2e: npm run pretest && npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run pretest && npm run format:check && vitest run && npm run build && npm run check:imports && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts

author: LZQCN
